verdict.rationale: LibreOffice documents a headless batch converter (--convert-to with wildcards and --outdir) and a large filter list that exports to open or portable formats such as PDF, EPUB, SVG, Parquet and OOXML. A community user independently confirms running it in Docker to normalize document formats, so users can bulk-convert their files and move to other tools. missing for 10: explicit evidence on its native open format (ODF), evidence of export fidelity when moving to other tools, coverage of Base database export.
